preconditions.description: The number of rows R must be between 1 and 1000.
The number of columns C must be between 1 and 20.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= cell <= 1 for row in matrix for cell in row)
preconditions.description: All cells in the matrix must contain either 0 or 1.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(row, int) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: The output must be a list of integers representing the row numbers.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= row < len(matrix) for row in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each row number in the output must be a valid index within the matrix.

postconditions.expression: len(return_value) == len(set(tuple(row) for row in matrix)) - len(set(tuple(row) for row in matrix if matrix.count(row) == 1))
postconditions.description: The output must contain the correct number of duplicate row indices.
